style.name: 3D Abstract CGI
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick #118: 3D Abstract CGI. Use an original premium editorial CGI language with sculptural three-dimensional forms, physically plausible materials, refined studio lighting, cinematic depth, soft volumetric atmosphere and precise infographic overlays. Every poster must build a distinct news-specific world with recognizable objects, environments and character interaction rather than repeating generic spheres, floating cards or abstract backgrounds. Text sits on calm, low-texture, high-contrast surfaces. Each poster has one main conclusion and no more than three key facts in 3-5 readable modules, with large type, generous line spacing and breathing room. News scenes, evidence and infographics occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. NO.01 is the exception: preserve all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly around a central 3D globe or world-stage scene, using staggered orbital ribbons, varied sculptural information surfaces and layered foreground-background storytelling rather than a rigid eight-cell grid, table, equal cards, dense borders or tiny type. Each text block needs a quiet, low-texture reading field and the surrounding illustration must yield space to the copy. Chinese and English must keep the same composition, scene, hierarchy and rhythm. Every raw image must be native 1:2 portrait, every final image exactly 887x1774, with natural undistorted faces, circles, type and characters, and the artwork must fill all four edges with zero non-design white strips, pillarbox, letterbox or scaling gaps.

zh-CN.headlineView: 前沿Agent、单人课程、AI音乐收入、跨境护肤、加沙人道核验、防务创新、宏观稳定与家庭韧性进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.headlineFull: 10月13日全球经营雷达；前沿Agent、单人课程、AI音乐收入、跨境护肤、加沙人道核验、防务创新、宏观稳定与家庭韧性进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.intro:
1. Meta发布Muse Wonder与Wonder Full，以Active Memory和Active Focus处理跨对话、长周期的个人与专业Agent任务。
2. CodeFast一人运营，用169美元课程和299美元组合包教创业者借助AI快速做产品，近30天验证收入5369美元。
3. Composer.AI把文字想法变成原创歌曲，RevenueCat验证近30天收入78157美元、MRR 73028美元。
4. 美国护肤品牌Beekman 1802上线跨境托管后，国际销售增长137%，国际订单客单价比国内高40%。
5. 联合国人权办公室称加沙停火宣布一年后仍持续发生致命袭击，已核验截至7月底1076起冲突相关死亡。
6. 欧盟理事会正式通过1.15亿欧元AGILE计划，帮助中小企业把颠覆性防务技术从原型推向实战能力。
7. Hall与Woodford因宏观稳定政策的微观基础获得2026年经济学奖，其模型已被央行和财政部门广泛使用。
8. 2026国际减灾日以“韧性始于家”为主题，把土地规划、建筑标准、预警和家庭准备连成一条防灾链。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同信号，是把长期记忆、真实收入、制度资金与家庭安全都落到可验证的行动链。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先看谁在使用、谁在付费、谁能执行，再判断新闻会怎样改变现实。

en-US.headlineView: Frontier agents, a solo course, AI music revenue, cross-border skincare, Gaza verification, defence innovation, macro stabilisation and household resilience enter one action map
en-US.headlineFull: October 13 Global Operator Radar; Frontier agents, a solo course, AI music revenue, cross-border skincare, Gaza verification, defence innovation, macro stabilisation and household resilience enter one action map
en-US.intro:
1. Meta launched Muse Wonder and Wonder Full, using Active Memory and Active Focus for personal and professional agent work across conversations and long-running tasks.
2. One-person CodeFast sells a $169 course and $299 bundle teaching entrepreneurs to build with AI, with $5,369 in verified 30-day revenue.
3. Composer.AI turns text ideas into original songs, with RevenueCat verifying $78,157 in 30-day revenue and $73,028 MRR.
4. US skincare brand Beekman 1802 grew international sales 137% after enabling managed cross-border commerce, while international AOV ran 40% above domestic orders.
5. UN Human Rights says deadly attacks continued through the year after Gaza's ceasefire announcement, with 1,076 conflict-related deaths verified through July.
6. The EU Council formally adopted the €115 million AGILE programme to help SMEs move disruptive defence technology from prototype to operational capability.
7. Hall and Woodford won the 2026 economics prize for microfoundations of macroeconomic stabilisation, models now widely used by central banks and finance ministries.
8. The 2026 disaster-risk day theme “Resilience Starts at Home” connects land use, building standards, warnings and household preparedness into one protection chain.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's shared signal is to turn long memory, real revenue, public funding and household safety into verifiable action chains.
en-US.doudouQuote: See who uses it, who pays and who can execute before deciding how the news changes reality.

zh-CN.headlineView: Active Memory跨对话记住重要信息，Active Focus在长任务中重试、纠错并在关键动作前确认
zh-CN.headlineFull: Meta发布Muse Wonder前沿Agent模型；Active Memory跨对话记住重要信息，Active Focus在长任务中重试、纠错并在关键动作前确认
zh-CN.intro: Meta于10月12日发布Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full，定位为面向个人和专业Agent任务的前沿模型。官方称其Active Memory可在多轮、多天任务中提取与目标相关的信息，Active Focus则会在困难任务里尝试其他路径、从错误中恢复，并在重要动作前请求澄清或确认。Muse Wonder已通过Meta Model API与Muse Code提供，Full版本先向Muse Code订阅者开放，随后进入Muse。能力覆盖合同、保险、财务、健康和编程，但官方尚未发布完整安全报告，性能也需要独立评测；长期记忆接入消息、日历与文档后，权限边界与隐私仍是产品门槛。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 长期Agent的竞争点，正在从一次回答转向记忆、恢复与谨慎执行。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 记得更多也意味着权限更大，默认确认不能省。

en-US.headlineFact: Meta launches Muse Wonder frontier agent models
en-US.headlineView: Active Memory carries relevant context across conversations, while Active Focus retries, recovers and checks before important actions
en-US.headlineFull: Meta launches Muse Wonder frontier agent models; Active Memory carries relevant context across conversations, while Active Focus retries, recovers and checks before important actions
en-US.intro: Meta launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on October 12 as frontier models for personal and professional agent tasks. The company says Active Memory retrieves goal-relevant information across conversations and multi-day work, while Active Focus tries alternate paths, recovers from errors and asks for clarification or confirmation before important actions. Muse Wonder is available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code; Full starts with Muse Code subscribers before broader Muse rollout. Use cases span leases, insurance, finance, health and coding, but a full safety report is still pending and performance needs independent testing. Once persistent memory reaches messages, calendars and documents, permission boundaries and privacy become product gates.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The contest for long-running agents is moving from one answer to memory, recovery and cautious execution.
en-US.doudouQuote: More memory means more privilege, so default confirmation cannot disappear.

zh-CN.headlineFact: CodeFast一人课程近30天验证收入5369美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 把“用AI做出可卖产品”包装成169美元课程与299美元创业组合包
zh-CN.headlineFull: CodeFast一人课程近30天验证收入5369美元；把“用AI做出可卖产品”包装成169美元课程与299美元创业组合包
zh-CN.intro: TrustMRR显示，新加坡一人运营的CodeFast累计验证收入833301美元，近30天收入5369美元，收入由Stripe验证。产品卖给想快速做出SaaS或线上生意的创业者和编程初学者，单课169美元，搭配ShipFast的组合包299美元，交付为可重复销售的自学课程与代码产品。创始人在X拥有约40.9万关注者，这个自有受众是明显获客杠杆；一次性定价意味着收入依赖持续新客，而不是订阅续费。利润率、退款率和支持时间未披露，AI开发教学更新快、创始人个人品牌集中度高，是当前限制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人课程生意的杠杆，是把经验压成可重复交付的结果路径。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一次性销售能赚现金，但新客流量和内容更新必须一直补。

en-US.headlineView: It packages “build a sellable product with AI” into a $169 course and a $299 entrepreneur bundle
en-US.headlineFull: One-person CodeFast verifies $5,369 in 30-day revenue; It packages “build a sellable product with AI” into a $169 course and a $299 entrepreneur bundle
en-US.intro: TrustMRR shows Singapore-based, one-person CodeFast at $833,301 in verified lifetime revenue and $5,369 over the last 30 days, verified through Stripe. It sells to entrepreneurs and coding beginners who want to ship SaaS or online businesses faster: the course costs $169, while a ShipFast bundle costs $299. Delivery is a repeatable self-paced course plus code product. The founder's roughly 409,000 followers on X provide a clear owned-distribution advantage. One-time pricing means revenue depends on a continuing stream of new buyers rather than renewals. Profit margin, refunds and support time are undisclosed; fast-changing AI-development lessons and founder-brand concentration remain limits.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A solo course business compounds by compressing experience into a repeatable path to an outcome.
en-US.doudouQuote: One-off sales create cash, but new-customer flow and lesson updates must keep arriving.

zh-CN.headlineView: 把文字灵感变成原创歌曲，用6.99美元周订阅与69美元年订阅完成消费级变现
zh-CN.headlineFull: Composer.AI验证MRR 73028美元；把文字灵感变成原创歌曲，用6.99美元周订阅与69美元年订阅完成消费级变现
zh-CN.intro: TrustMRR显示，Composer.AI旗下SongMaker.AI累计验证收入2111880美元，近30天收入78157美元、MRR 73028美元，有5603个活跃订阅，数据由RevenueCat验证。产品面向音乐爱好者、专业音乐人和教育用户，把文字创意转成原创歌曲；AI落地点是将作曲与生成门槛压缩到一个移动端工作流。变现来自6.99美元周订阅与69美元年订阅，4.7分和2019条App Store评分提供社会证明。收入成立，但团队规模、推理与版权成本、退款和留存未披露；周订阅的用户价值、生成音乐权利边界与模型成本是主要风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 消费AI的付费点，不是“会生成”，而是几分钟内拿到能使用的作品。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 高MRR之后，要继续追问留存、版权和每首歌的推理毛利。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：赚钱的AI应用落地。

en-US.headlineView: It turns text ideas into original songs and monetizes with a $6.99 weekly plan and $69 annual plan
en-US.headlineFull: Composer.AI verifies $73,028 MRR; It turns text ideas into original songs and monetizes with a $6.99 weekly plan and $69 annual plan
en-US.intro: TrustMRR reports $2,111,880 in verified lifetime revenue for Composer.AI's SongMaker.AI, including $78,157 over the last 30 days and $73,028 MRR from 5,603 active subscriptions, verified through RevenueCat. It targets music enthusiasts, professionals and educators, using AI to compress composition and generation into one mobile workflow. Monetization comes from a $6.99 weekly plan and $69 annual plan; a 4.7 rating across 2,019 App Store reviews supplies social proof. Revenue is real, but team size, inference and rights costs, refunds and retention are undisclosed. Weekly-subscription value, music-rights boundaries and model cost are the main risks.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The paid value in consumer AI is not that it generates, but that it delivers a usable work in minutes.
en-US.doudouQuote: After strong MRR, keep asking about retention, rights and inference margin per song.

zh-CN.headlineView: 山羊奶护肤需求通过关税、物流与商品限制托管，几周内进入150多个国家
zh-CN.headlineFull: Beekman 1802国际销售增长137%；山羊奶护肤需求通过关税、物流与商品限制托管，几周内进入150多个国家
zh-CN.intro: Shopify案例显示，美国山羊奶护肤品牌Beekman 1802启用Managed Markets后，约六个月国际销售增长137%，国际销售占比提高2.5倍，国际订单客单价比国内高40%，跨境转化率提高23%，英国转化率提高43%。目标市场从加拿大扩到150多个国家，获客依赖已有品牌内容、零售与电视曝光带来的海外需求；赚钱机制是让原本因运费、关税和监管而流失的访问转成更高客单订单。交付仍从现有仓库发货，平台协助关税、物流和受限商品管理。案例未披露毛利、退货率与平台费用，护肤合规、税费和国际履约仍会侵蚀增长。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境需求早已存在时，先把关税和履约摩擦从结账里拿走。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 销售增幅要和高客单一起看，也要扣掉退货、税费与平台成本。

en-US.headlineView: Managed duties, logistics and catalog restrictions open goat-milk skincare demand to more than 150 countries within weeks
en-US.headlineFull: Beekman 1802 grows international sales 137%; Managed duties, logistics and catalog restrictions open goat-milk skincare demand to more than 150 countries within weeks
en-US.intro: Shopify's case study says US goat-milk skincare brand Beekman 1802 grew international sales 137% in roughly six months after enabling Managed Markets. International share rose 2.5 times, international AOV ran 40% above domestic orders, global conversion improved 23% and UK conversion 43%. The target expanded from Canada to more than 150 countries. Existing brand content, retail and television exposure created overseas demand; the earning mechanism was converting traffic lost to shipping, duties and regulation into larger orders. Fulfilment still uses existing warehouses while the platform manages duties, logistics and restricted items. Gross margin, returns and platform fees are undisclosed, while cosmetics compliance, taxes and international fulfilment can erode growth.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When cross-border demand already exists, remove duties and fulfilment friction from checkout first.
en-US.doudouQuote: Read sales growth beside higher AOV, then subtract returns, taxes and platform cost.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 联合国称加沙停火宣布一年后致命袭击仍未停止
zh-CN.headlineView: 截至7月底核验1076起冲突相关死亡，“黄线”附近边界移动令平民风险持续扩大
zh-CN.headlineFull: 联合国称加沙停火宣布一年后致命袭击仍未停止；截至7月底核验1076起冲突相关死亡，“黄线”附近边界移动令平民风险持续扩大
zh-CN.intro: 联合国巴勒斯坦办事处10月12日发布人权简报称，自2025年10月10日停火宣布以来，加沙仍持续发生致命袭击和反复流离失所。联合国人权办公室已核验截至2026年7月底1076起冲突相关死亡，其中包括268名儿童和126名女性；巴勒斯坦卫生部门报告的全年死亡超过1400人。简报指出，以军部署范围和所谓“黄线”不断内移，使平民难以识别安全边界；截至7月底，联合国核验黄线附近死亡331人。以色列方面的回应未在该简报中呈现，数字与法律判断应按来源归属理解。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 停火的可信度，最终要由平民伤亡、边界可识别性和问责来检验。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把核验数字、报告数字和法律判断分开，才能准确阅读冲突信息。

en-US.headlineFact: The UN says deadly attacks continued through the year after Gaza's ceasefire announcement
en-US.headlineView: UN Human Rights verified 1,076 conflict-related deaths through July as a shifting “yellow line” kept civilian risk expanding
en-US.headlineFull: The UN says deadly attacks continued through the year after Gaza's ceasefire announcement; UN Human Rights verified 1,076 conflict-related deaths through July as a shifting “yellow line” kept civilian risk expanding
en-US.intro: A UN Palestine human-rights briefing published October 12 says deadly attacks and repeated displacement continued in Gaza after the ceasefire announced on October 10, 2025. UN Human Rights verified 1,076 conflict-related deaths through the end of July 2026, including 268 children and 126 women; the Palestinian health authorities report more than 1,400 deaths over the full year. The briefing says Israeli deployment areas and the so-called yellow line moved inward, making safe boundaries hard for civilians to identify; 331 deaths near that line were verified through July. Israel's response is not presented in the briefing, so casualty figures and legal assessments should remain attributed to their sources.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A ceasefire's credibility is ultimately tested by civilian deaths, identifiable boundaries and accountability.
en-US.doudouQuote: Separate verified counts, reported counts and legal assessments to read conflict information accurately.

sources.title: One year after ceasefire announcement, killings continue across Gaza

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟正式通过1.15亿欧元AGILE防务创新计划
zh-CN.headlineView: 中小企业、初创与成长企业获得更快资金，把颠覆性技术从原型推进到可部署能力
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟正式通过1.15亿欧元AGILE防务创新计划；中小企业、初创与成长企业获得更快资金，把颠覆性技术从原型推进到可部署能力
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟理事会10月12日正式通过AGILE法规，设立1.15亿欧元工具，为开发新兴与颠覆性防务产品的中小企业、初创和成长企业提供快速、灵活、定向的资金。计划重点支持产品开发、测试，以及把民用技术改造为防务用途，填补“有原型但进不了部署”的资金与采购缺口。委员会早期方案预计支持约20至30个项目，最高覆盖合格成本的100%，目标2027年启动。机会在于AI、无人系统、量子和网络安全等双用途团队，但预算来自现有项目重分配，企业仍要面对军事需求验证、出口管制、采购周期和伦理边界。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 创新基金的价值，不在宣布预算，而在缩短原型到现场能力的距离。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 快钱也要过需求验证、采购规则和出口合规三道门。

en-US.headlineFact: The EU formally adopts the €115 million AGILE defence-innovation programme
en-US.headlineView: Faster funding helps SMEs, start-ups and scale-ups move disruptive technology from prototype to deployable capability
en-US.headlineFull: The EU formally adopts the €115 million AGILE defence-innovation programme; Faster funding helps SMEs, start-ups and scale-ups move disruptive technology from prototype to deployable capability
en-US.intro: The EU Council formally adopted the AGILE regulation on October 12, creating a €115 million instrument for rapid, flexible and targeted support to SMEs, start-ups and scale-ups developing emerging and disruptive defence products. It focuses on development, testing and the adaptation of civilian technology for defence use, addressing the gap between a working prototype and operational deployment. The Commission's earlier design expected roughly 20 to 30 projects, up to 100% coverage of eligible costs, and operation from 2027. AI, unmanned systems, quantum and cybersecurity teams may benefit, but the budget is reallocated from existing programmes and companies still face military demand validation, export controls, procurement cycles and ethical boundaries.
en-US.xiaziQuote: An innovation fund matters when it shortens the distance from prototype to field capability.
en-US.doudouQuote: Fast money still passes three gates: demand validation, procurement rules and export compliance.

sources.title: €115 million Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation

zh-CN.headlineView: 把家庭与企业的真实决策写进宏观模型，重建央行和财政部门稳定通胀与衰退的工具箱
zh-CN.headlineFull: Hall与Woodford获2026年经济学奖；把家庭与企业的真实决策写进宏观模型，重建央行和财政部门稳定通胀与衰退的工具箱
zh-CN.intro: 瑞典皇家科学院把2026年经济学奖授予Robert E. Hall与Michael Woodford，表彰其“宏观经济稳定的微观基础”。Hall把家庭消费与劳动决策纳入周期分析，Woodford建立以价格设定、预期和利率规则为核心的现代货币政策框架；两条研究路线共同推动新凯恩斯模型成为央行与财政部门的重要决策工具。学院强调，这些模型帮助政策制定者量化利率、财政刺激与预期管理如何影响通胀和产出，但它们不是自动答案，仍依赖现实参数、制度可信度和对新冲击的持续校准。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 宏观政策要可信，必须能解释普通家庭与企业为何改变行为。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 模型给出结构，现实参数和政策可信度决定结果。

en-US.headlineFact: Hall and Woodford win the 2026 economics prize
en-US.headlineView: Putting household and firm decisions inside macro models rebuilt the policy toolkit for inflation and recessions
en-US.headlineFull: Hall and Woodford win the 2026 economics prize; Putting household and firm decisions inside macro models rebuilt the policy toolkit for inflation and recessions
en-US.intro: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2026 economics prize to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford “for microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation.” Hall integrated household consumption and labour choices into business-cycle analysis, while Woodford built a modern monetary-policy framework around price setting, expectations and interest-rate rules. Together, their work helped make New Keynesian models core tools for central banks and finance ministries. The Academy says the models let policymakers quantify how rates, fiscal support and expectations affect inflation and output, but they are not automatic answers: results still depend on real-world parameters, institutional credibility and continual recalibration for new shocks.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Macroeconomic policy becomes credible when it can explain why households and firms change behavior.
en-US.doudouQuote: Models provide structure; real parameters and policy credibility decide the outcome.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 国际减灾日把“韧性始于家”置于核心
zh-CN.headlineView: 住房安全不是家庭单独承担：土地规划、建筑标准、保险、预警与早期行动必须同时工作
zh-CN.headlineFull: 国际减灾日把“韧性始于家”置于核心；住房安全不是家庭单独承担：土地规划、建筑标准、保险、预警与早期行动必须同时工作
zh-CN.intro: 10月13日国际减灾日的2026主题是“韧性始于家”。联合国减灾署指出，灾害每年损坏或摧毁数百万套住房，家庭既是风险最直接的承受者，也是准备与恢复的最小行动单位。可执行链条包括政府用风险信息指导土地规划和建筑标准，企业改变住房建造、融资与保险方式，社区确保预警覆盖所有高风险人群，家庭则了解本地灾害并预先约定行动。重点不是把责任推给个人，而是让制度、市场和家庭在同一套风险信息上协同。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 家庭韧性不是囤一只应急包，而是住址、标准、预警和行动都对得上风险。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先确认你所在位置的风险，再把收到预警后的第一步写清楚。

en-US.headlineFact: International disaster-risk day puts “Resilience Starts at Home” at the center
en-US.headlineView: Housing safety is not a household burden alone: land use, building codes, insurance, warnings and early action must work together
en-US.headlineFull: International disaster-risk day puts “Resilience Starts at Home” at the center; Housing safety is not a household burden alone: land use, building codes, insurance, warnings and early action must work together
en-US.intro: The 2026 theme for International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction on October 13 is “Resilience Starts at Home.” UNDRR says disasters damage or destroy millions of homes each year, making households both the most immediate risk bearers and the smallest unit of preparedness and recovery. The actionable chain runs from governments using risk information in land-use plans and building standards, to businesses shaping construction, finance and insurance, to communities ensuring warnings reach everyone at risk, and families knowing local hazards and agreeing early actions. The point is not to shift responsibility onto individuals, but to align institutions, markets and households around the same risk information.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Household resilience is not one emergency bag; location, standards, warnings and action must match the risk.
en-US.doudouQuote: Identify the hazards where you live, then write down the first action after a warning arrives.
